summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchases under its existing buyback programme. Over 13-14 August 2026, it bought 694,223 ordinary shares at volume-weighted average prices around 703-704 GBp per share, with aggregate consideration roughly £4.9 million. Purchases were executed through UBS AG London Branch on LSE, CHIX, and BATE venues, and shares will be cancelled. Following settlement, NatWest holds 178,425,903 treasury shares and 7,959,360,062 shares in issue. This is a routine buyback disclosure under UK Market Abuse Regulation, consistent with ongoing capital return strategy. Watch for continued weekly execution under the programme.
